traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): order leaves one per node, two-ranked in most families, spiral in Magnoliaceae and Degeneriaceae; never opposite.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): order characterisation gives two-ranked leaves; Annonaceae (largest family, about 2,400 spp.), Myristicaceae, Himantandraceae and Eupomatiaceae two-ranked; Magnoliaceae and Degeneriaceae spiral. 'usually' weighed by species.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): blades undivided throughout (Liriodendron lobed but one piece).

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): order largely tropical woody plants; deciduous only noted in Liriodendron and some Magnolia. 'usually' inferred from the tropical distribution of Annonaceae and Myristicaceae (a few temperate Annonaceae such as Asimina shed leaves).

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): all members trees, shrubs or lianas (Eupomatia rhizomatous shrubs).

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): woody plants with leaves spaced along branches; no rosettes described.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): Annonaceae inflorescences terminal in origin but often displaced to leaf-opposed or axillary positions along the branch; Myristicaceae and Degeneriaceae axillary; Magnoliaceae flowers terminal. 'usually lateral' is our weighting for how the two big families look; medium confidence.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): flowers radially symmetric in all families.

traits.flower_merosity.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): Annonaceae and Myristicaceae parts in threes; Degeneriaceae three sepals; Liriodendron perianth 3+3.

traits.perianth.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): Annonaceae sepals 3 plus petals 3+3; Myristicaceae a single connate whorl; Magnoliaceae tepals; Eupomatiaceae none (calyptra). Weighted by Annonaceae.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): receptacle flat or conical in most families; only Eupomatiaceae has a concave receptacle.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): free carpels on a receptacle in most families; Eupomatiaceae carpels sunk in the receptacle.

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): Annonaceae stalked berrylets in a cluster; Magnoliaceae follicles on a cone-like axis; Myristicaceae a single dehiscent fleshy fruit; Degeneriaceae a follicle. Weighted by Annonaceae.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Magnoliales page (read 2026-10-16): flowers bisexual in Annonaceae (some monoecious tribes), Magnoliaceae and small families; Myristicaceae dioecious.
